selection.assetRule: unique asset ids actually placed by the 14 checked-in ps_seed object ledgers
selection.slotRule: all body/shadow slots declared by standing, alternate-state, and composite crushed-state ledger fields
selection.canonicalDuplicateRule: last manifest entry for an id/slot wins, matching SpriteIndex.slots
selection.usageDefinition: one use per selected object ledger record; a composite fence record counts once regardless of its simultaneous segment slots

shadowPolicy.bodyAuthority: the accepted photorealistic generated HD body cutout
shadowPolicy.canonicalShadowRole: calibration only: anchor, direction, footprint, extent, penumbra, and density
shadowPolicy.forbidden: copying, tracing, pasting, recoloring, scaling, or otherwise reusing canonical shadow pixels as the HD shadow
shadowPolicy.alignmentInvariant: the generated shadow begins at the generated body's exact ground-contact point and travels toward screen lower-right
